name: Nate Dollard
strengths: Dollard uses 6-0 length to stay stacked on the perimeter and disrupt releases at the line.
Dollard shows patience in man coverage — does not bite early on stems.
Dollard closes to the football and contests catches with long arms at the catch point.
weaknesses: Dollard still needs to add significant mass to his 160-pound frame for SEC outside durability.
comparison: Dollard comps to Derek Stingley Jr. — 6-0 length corner who stacks receivers, stays patient in phase, and contests with arm length.
projection: Dollard projects as a Year 2–3 SEC starter at CB (special teams / nickel Year 1). Ceiling: every-down SEC press corner — the length CB who can lock the boundary once strength catches the frame.
schemeFit: Dollard fits White’s press/man boundary CB who wins with length and patience before the frame fills.
insiderNotes: Dollard is a lean 6-0 Providence Day corner who wins with length, patience in man, and catch-point contests. Frame still needs mass at 160. Wins with phase discipline — a high-upside NC CB for Florida’s press room.
